title: coryphantha clava
intro: Coryphantha clava, commonly known as the chain fruit cholla, is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. This plant is known for its unique chain-like fruits and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Coryphantha clava include wound healing, pain relief, and reducing inflammation, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. Research on the bioactive constituents of Coryphantha clava has identified the presence of compounds like scopoletin, flavanones, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
